name: editorial-week
title: Editorial performance review
subtitle: Imported snapshots. Partial exports cover included stories only.

sections.title: Current stories
sections.sql: select publication,title,start_on,end_on,views,seconds_per_view,coverage from story_performance order by views desc

sections.title: Comparable declines
sections.sql: select title,previous_start,start_on,end_on,previous_views,views,change_pct,coverage from story_comparison where change_pct<0 order by change_pct

sections.title: Follow-up
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due_on from actions_due order by due_on

sections.title: Checks requiring review
sections.sql: select * from compliance_checks order by rule,reference
